author: Catherine Baker
raw_text:
Electronic Health Information (EHI) Export

File Formats These are standardized computable formats. The export (s) will include one or more of
the formats below depending on set-up and use of the system by the agency.

Single Patient:

   •   CCD/C-CDA documents
       Consolidated Clinical Document Architecture which will contain data required by the USCDI
       v1 standards.

   •   JSON
       JavaScript Object Notation. JSON is a lightweight format for storing and transporting data.
       JSON is in plain text, which is readable by a person, but is meant to be parsed and
       understood by an application or web page.

   •   PDF documents
       Portable Document Format, is a ﬁle format to present documents, including text formatting
       and image.

Patient Population:

   •   .bak ﬁle
       This is a full MSSQL Server database backup of all data for an agency that can be restored.
